description:
Create a proportional symbol map of world cities in gvSIG Desktop.

1. Open gvSIG Desktop (if not already open).
2. Open the 'countries_base.gvsproj' project (or start a new view with 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp').
3. Add the 'ne_110m_populated_places.shp' layer from `/home/ga/gvsig_data/cities/` to the View.
4. Open the Properties for the populated places layer.
5. Change the Symbology to 'Quantities' > 'Graduated symbols' (or 'Proportional symbols').
6. Select 'POP_MAX' as the Value field.
7. Adjust the settings so cities are displayed as circles with varying sizes based on population (e.g., min size 4, max size 20).
8. Apply the changes so the map shows larger circles for bigger cities.
9. Save the project as `/home/ga/gvsig_data/projects/proportional_cities.gvsproj`.
10. Export the map view as an image to `/home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/proportional_cities.png`.
